Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification-Mass Spectrometry) using a FLAG-tagged Scube2 bait to identify interacting proteins. Although PRIDE metadata lists SWATH and SRM/MRM in experimentTypes, the actual Methods text explicitly describes 'Top24 data-dependent acquisition' (DDA) on an Orbitrap Exploris 480. Quantification was performed by ranking based on peptide counts (spectral counting/LFQ approach).
